released-to-settled.json.why: released is terminal: its ceiling was returned, so it can never also be charged (7.5).

settled-to-unknown.json.why: settled is terminal; settlement happens exactly once and is idempotent on attempt ID (7.6).

reserved-to-settled.json.why: An attempt cannot settle without being dispatched, since nothing was sent upstream to incur usage.

dispatched-to-released.json.why: Once a byte is sent upstream the ceiling cannot be released without charge; the attempt must settle or become unknown (7.5).

unknown-to-released.json.why: An unknown attempt resolves only by settling, with exact usage or the full ceiling; releasing it would let charges fall below true cost (7.5).

extra-property-note.json.why: A transition is exactly a from and to pair; extra fields could carry free text.
